item.title: Australia: Advanced Biomanufacturing Hub Launches in Victoria
item.description: Australia’s new cell-based vaccine facility in Victoria significantly enhances domestic production, strengthens pandemic preparedness, and positions the country as a leader in advanced, flexible biomanufacturing.

item.title: The Philippines: Strengthening Online Safety for Women and Children
item.description: The Philippines is strengthening digital literacy and safety programs through police-led initiatives and ChildFund projects to protect women and children from cybercrime and online exploitation.

item.title: Hong Kong: Smart Climate Resilience Laboratory for Coastal Cities
item.description: New state laboratory focuses on advanced climate modelling, resilient infrastructure technologies and improved early-warning systems to strengthen coastal cities against extreme weather impacts.

item.title: Vietnam: Greener, Smarter, Inclusive E-commerce Evolution
item.description: Vietnam’s e-commerce sector is growing sustainably, driven by digital innovation, greener logistics, regulatory oversight and support for SMEs to ensure inclusive and efficient market development.

item.title: Singapore–EU Digital Partnership Enters a New Phase
item.description: Singapore and the European Union have refreshed their Digital Partnership with cooperation across AI, cybersecurity, data flows and emerging technologies to strengthen innovation and digital resilience.

item.title: Malaysia Unveils Geospatial-Enabled National Data Platform
item.description: DOSM GEOFHUB integrates geospatial information with national statistics to enhance analysis, improve accessibility and support more informed, location-based decision-making across Malaysia’s public sector.

item.title: Vietnam: Emerging Hub for Versatile Humanoid Robotics
item.description: Vietnam is emerging as a key player in humanoid robotics, leveraging strengths in hardware, AI, software, research and safe deployment to advance versatile, autonomous, human-centred robotic systems.

item.title: Australia: NSW Expands AI Infrastructure With New Data Centre
item.description: New South Wales is set to strengthen its position as a leading technology hub with a AU$7 billion AI-focused data centre in Sydney, enhancing digital infrastructure, high-performance computing and regional innovation.

item.title: India: AI Underpins Vision for Intelligent Digital Infrastructure
item.description: India is rapidly integrating AI with its Digital Public Infrastructure to create scalable, citizen-centric and intelligent public services that enhance governance, inclusion and sector-specific innovation nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: SG$37 Billion Plan to Strengthen Research and Innovation
item.description: The S$37 billion RIE2030 plan deepens research capabilities, strengthens talent, drives high-impact innovation and advances the nation’s long-term economic and strategic priorities.
